# RV32GC. Only the cases where RV32 behaves differently from RV64 are worth
# repeating here: shift widths, `c.jal` (which RV64 spends on `c.addiw`),
# the `c.flw` family (which RV64 spends on `c.ld`), and `li`.

# ---- base ----
add a0, a1, a2
sub a0, a1, a2
sll a0, a1, a2
slt a0, a1, a2
sltu a0, a1, a2
xor a0, a1, a2
srl a0, a1, a2
sra a0, a1, a2
or a0, a1, a2
and a0, a1, a2
add a0, a0, a1
sub a0, a0, a1
addi a0, a1, 1
addi a0, a0, 1
addi sp, sp, -16
addi a0, sp, 16
andi a0, a0, 7
slti a0, a1, 3
sltiu a0, a1, 3
xori a0, a1, -1
ori a0, a1, 1

# ---- shifts: 31 is the widest on RV32 ----
slli a0, a1, 31
srli a0, a1, 31
srai a0, a1, 31
slli a0, a0, 1
srli a0, a0, 1
srai a0, a0, 1

# ---- loads and stores ----
lb a0, 0(a1)
lh a0, 2(a1)
lw a0, 4(a1)
lbu a0, 1(a1)
lhu a0, 2(a1)
lw a0, 4(sp)
lw a0, 124(a5)
sb a0, 0(a1)
sh a0, 2(a1)
sw a0, 4(a1)
sw a0, 4(sp)
sw ra, 12(sp)

# ---- branches ----
beq a0, a1, 8
bne a0, a1, -8
blt a0, a1, 16
bge a0, a1, 16
bltu a0, a1, 16
bgeu a0, a1, 16
beqz a0, 8
bnez a0, -8

# ---- jumps: `jal ra` has a compressed form only on RV32 ----
jal ra, 16
jal 16
jal x0, 16
jal a0, 16
j 16
jr a0
jalr a0
ret
call sym
tail sym

# ---- U-type ----
lui a0, 1
lui a0, 32
lui a0, 1048575
auipc a0, 1

# ---- M ----
mul a0, a1, a2
mulh a0, a1, a2
mulhsu a0, a1, a2
mulhu a0, a1, a2
div a0, a1, a2
divu a0, a1, a2
rem a0, a1, a2
remu a0, a1, a2

# ---- A ----
lr.w a0, (a1)
sc.w a0, a1, (a2)
sc.w.aqrl a0, a1, (a2)
amoswap.w a0, a1, (a2)
amoadd.w.aq a0, a1, (a2)
amomaxu.w a0, a1, (a2)

# ---- F: `flw`/`fsw` compress on RV32 ----
flw fa0, 8(sp)
flw fa0, 4(a1)
flw fa0, 128(a1)
fsw fa0, 8(sp)
fsw fa0, 4(a1)
fadd.s fa0, fa1, fa2
fsub.s fa0, fa1, fa2
fmul.s fa0, fa1, fa2
fdiv.s fa0, fa1, fa2
fsqrt.s fa0, fa1
fadd.s fa0, fa1, fa2, rtz
fmadd.s fa0, fa1, fa2, fa3
feq.s a0, fa1, fa2
fcvt.w.s a0, fa0
fcvt.s.w fa0, a0
fmv.x.w a0, fa1
fmv.w.x fa0, a1
fmv.s fa0, fa1
fneg.s fa0, fa1
fabs.s fa0, fa1

# ---- D ----
fld fa0, 8(sp)
fld fa0, 8(a1)
fsd fa0, 8(sp)
fsd fa0, 8(a1)
fadd.d fa0, fa1, fa2
fcvt.s.d fa0, fa1
fcvt.d.s fa0, fa1
fcvt.d.w fa0, a0
fmv.d fa0, fa1

# ---- pseudo-instructions ----
nop
mv a0, a1
not a0, a1
neg a0, a1
seqz a0, a1
snez a0, a1
sltz a0, a1
sgtz a0, a1
blez a0, 8
bgez a0, 8
bltz a0, 8
bgtz a0, 8
bgt a0, a1, 8
ble a0, a1, 8
bgtu a0, a1, 8
bleu a0, a1, 8

# ---- li: at most lui+addi on RV32 ----
li a0, 0
li a0, 1
li a0, -1
li a0, 31
li a0, 32
li a0, 2047
li a0, 2048
li a0, -2048
li a0, -2049
li a0, 4096
li a0, 0x12345678
li a0, 0x7fffffff
li a0, -0x80000000
li a0, 0xffffffff
li a0, 0xfffff000
li a0, 0x800

# ---- system and CSR ----
ecall
ebreak
fence
fence.i
fence r, w
csrr a0, mstatus
csrw mstatus, a0
csrrw a0, mstatus, a1
csrrwi a0, fcsr, 7
rdcycle a0

# ---- relocation modifiers ----
lui a0, %hi(sym)
addi a0, a0, %lo(sym)
lw a0, %lo(sym)(a1)
sw a0, %lo(sym)(a1)
auipc a0, %pcrel_hi(sym)
